description.value: Little Beetle (also known as Little Beetle Bistro) is a regional cuisine restaurant that opened in August 2024, tucked into a unit on Vedder Road in Chilliwack. It is a no-reservation, sit-down spot with air conditioning and full wheelchair accessibility. Cyclists travelling the Vedder Road corridor will find it a convenient stop for a meal in a comfortable indoor setting.

address.value: 6640 Vedder Road, Unit J1, Chilliwack, BC V2R 4E1
